cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Flat. Definitely flat. I'll have what you're having—two flat whites while your car's in the garage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether the front tyre was flat. Why did you book it in?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, the front. We'll take the table by the front window. You can choose the pastries.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask the mechanic about the car before the coffees come.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Order with me first—was it two sugars? I'll get your breakfast exactly right. We can wave him over once we've chosen something for him too.
